textbookBox.concept: Bela lives with her parents, her brothers Banku and Bishu, and her grandparents. Together they are one family. The children play chhupan-chhupai, hide and seek, in the open space outside their house.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Bela lives with her parents, her brothers Banku and Bishu, and her grandparents. Together they are one family. The children play chhupan-chhupai, hide and seek, in the open space outside their house.
beats.speakEn: Bela lives with her parents, her brothers Banku and Bishu, and her grandparents. Together they are one family. The children play chhupan-chhupai, hide and seek, in the open space outside their house.

beats.en: On rainy days the family sits under a small shelter in the garden. It is great fun to sit outside when it rains. They play games such as antakshari and snakes and ladders.
beats.speakEn: On rainy days the family sits under a small shelter in the garden. It is great fun to sit outside when it rains. They play games such as antakshari and snakes and ladders.

textbookBox.concept: Bela's grandfather, Dadaji, taught Banku and Bela the games he played with his friends when he was young. He joins in their games too.

beats.en: Bela's grandfather, Dadaji, taught Banku and Bela the games he played with his friends when he was young. He joins in their games too. Shiru, the dog, is a member of the family and has a special place in the home.
beats.speakEn: Bela's grandfather, Dadaji, taught Banku and Bela the games he played with his friends when he was young. He joins in their games too. Shiru, the dog, is a member of the family and has a special place in the home.

beats.en: Families are big and small and different, and we love them all. A family can have a few or many members.
